summary: Preserve JavaScript static field inheritance and shadow-on-write semantics across class constructor objects.

target.notes: Represent static fields as properties on JavaScript-compatible constructor objects with prototype linkage between subclass and superclass constructors.

semantics.write_through_subclass: B.x = v creates/updates B own property under ordinary Set semantics

caveats: A C# inherited static field is one shared storage location, so `B.x = 2` would incorrectly mutate A.x.

tests.name: inherited read
tests.input: class A { static x=1; } class B extends A {} console.log(B.x);

tests.name: edge: subclass write does not mutate base own field
tests.input: class A { static x=1; } class B extends A {} B.x=2; console.log(A.x,B.x);
